raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
This draft is stacked on #42498 by @amd-pedghazi, which is itself stacked on #41900 by @AMD-yanfeiwang. Only the last three commits are new here; everything below them is #42498 as of 91b80c0. It should land after both, and I will rebase it as they change. To review only this PR's change, see [its three commits](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44009/files/91b80c03fc95ced9724c9197acb73682d81faa62..900d5cfdac2a73f2180332e15d99c5c84ca3f706).

## Motivation

#41900 and #42498 replace AITER's MoE sort and the stage-1 MXFP8 quant with one small Triton launch, but `_small_sort_supported` turns the path off whenever `expert_mask` is set. Under expert parallelism the mask is always set, so EP deployments never get the fused path. MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL at TP8/EP8 on MI355X is one such case: the 384 experts are split 48 per rank, and every decode step pays AITER's masked sort plus a separate quant in each of its 69 MoE layers.

## Modifications

- `_localize_experts`: maps global expert ids to local ids, the number of local experts below each one, which is the numbering AITER's masked `moe_sorting` emits. Pairs routed to another rank become the kernel's sentinel and drop out of the sort.
- `_moe_sorting_small_kernel` (P <= 64) and `_moe_sorting_small_kernel_sorted` (32 < P <= 256) take a `HAS_MASK` constexpr and localize the ids in-kernel. The fused MXFP8 quant still writes every token's fp8 row and writes scale bytes only for local pairs, as AITER does.
- `_small_sort_supported` admits a masked batch only when it fits one of those two kernels and the mask is a contiguous int32 tensor of length `num_experts`. The distributed variant does not localize, so masked batches never reach it. Calls with `num_local_tokens` still go to AITER.
- `moe_buf` is always allocated zeroed under a mask, because EP stage 2 accumulates only the local experts.
- A one-time `logger.info` when the path first serves a masked batch, so a deployment can confirm it is active.
- Tests: `TestMoeSortingSmallExpertMask` checks sort outputs, the shared-expert layout and the fused quant against AITER's masked `moe_sorting`, for MiMo's 384 experts with top-8 and DeepSeek-V4.1's 385 with top-7. It also checks that the gate keeps unsupported masked shapes on AITER.

82 lines in `moe_sorting_small.py` (+78/−4) and 151 lines of tests.

## Accuracy Tests

- Unit tests on MI355X: the whole of `test/registered/amd/test_moe_sorting_small.py` passes, 9 tests and 192 subtests, including the 4 new masked tests. Masked outputs are compared exactly against stock AITER.
- MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL MXFP4, TP8/EP8, same node, same seeds: GPQA-diamond 0.722 with this PR against 0.732 without. That is within run-to-run noise for 198 questions; B200 reference runs score 0.717–0.732.
- NIAH has not completed yet. The first attempt ended in a cluster node failure, not in this code; a rerun is queued.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Microbenchmark on one MI355X: MiMo's shape (384 experts, top-8) with EP8 rank 0's mask, block 32, CUDA-graph replay. Times are the sort plus stage-1 MXFP8 quant per MoE layer. AITER is the masked sort followed by the separate quant, which is what these calls run on #42498 alone.

| Tokens | AITER (µs) | This PR (µs) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 11.39 | 2.86 |
| 2 | 11.61 | 2.95 |
| 4 | 11.69 | 3.84 |
| 8 | 11.85 | 4.37 |
| 16 | 12.81 | 4.76 |
| 32 | 9.62 | 5.33 |

End to end: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL MXFP4, TP8/EP8, MI355X, `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi35x-20261011` with MiMo-specific tuning patches. Each pair ran stock, then this PR, on one node with identical prompts and seeds. All 8 ranks logged the fused path as active.

| Input/output, concurrency | Node | Output tok/s | Mean TPOT (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8k/1k, c4 | 176 | 347.8 → 359.3 (+3.3%) | 11.01 → 10.65 (−3.3%) |
| 8k/1k, c16 | 012 | 1009.4 → 1033.7 (+2.4%) | 14.38 → 14.04 (−2.4%) |
| 8k/1k, c16 | 047 | 1006.9 → 1032.7 (+2.6%) | 14.44 → 14.04 (−2.8%) |
| 8k/1k, c32 | 018 | 1520.2 → 1544.8 (+1.6%) | 18.27 → 17.95 (−1.8%) |
| 60k/600, c16 | 018 | 293.9 → 303.1 (+3.1%) | 40.23 → 39.56 (−1.7%) |

Above 32 concurrent requests at top-8, P exceeds 256 and the path hands back to AITER, so higher concurrencies are unchanged by design. A full 12-point sweep is queued.

These numbers come from the same source change applied to v0.5.21. The three commits rebase onto #42498's current head without conflicts, and neither touched file differs from the tested build, but I have not yet re-run them on main.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -15,6 +15,7 @@
 
 import functools
 import logging
+import math
 from contextvars import ContextVar
 
 import torch
@@ -26,6 +27,22 @@
 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
 
+@triton.jit
+def _localize_experts(
+    e, valid, expert_mask_ptr, num_experts, E_POW2: tl.constexpr, SENTINEL
+):
+    # EP: global expert id -> local id (number of local experts below it), as aiter's
+    # masked sort emits; pairs routed to another rank become SENTINEL and drop out
+    offs_e = tl.arange(0, E_POW2)
+    m = (tl.load(expert_mask_ptr + offs_e, mask=offs_e < num_experts, other=0) != 0).to(
+        tl.int32
+    )
+    local = tl.cumsum(m, 0) - m
+    e_safe = tl.where(valid, e, 0)
+    is_local = valid & (tl.gather(m, e_safe, 0) != 0)
+    return tl.where(is_local, tl.gather(local, e_safe, 0), SENTINEL), is_local
+
+
 # P <= 64: one sort CTA does the whole P x P rank compare
 # per-M ints stay unspecialized so prefill sizes reuse the graph-capture compiles
 @triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["M", "moe_buf_numel", "num_buf"])
@@ -41,13 +58,17 @@ def _moe_sorting_small_kernel(
     qx_ptr,  # [M, N_COLS] activations to mx-quantize (EMIT_MX only)
     qout_ptr,  # [M, N_COLS] fp8 out
     qscale_ptr,  # swizzled e8m0 bytes, one per (sorted_row, group)
+    expert_mask_ptr,  # [num_experts] i32, 1 = expert on this rank (HAS_MASK only)
     M,
+    num_experts,
     TOPK: tl.constexpr,
     BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
     P_POW2: tl.constexpr,  # >= M * topk
+    E_POW2: tl.constexpr,  # > num_experts (HAS_MASK only)
     PAD_POW2: tl.constexpr,  # >= (M * topk) * BLOCK_SIZE (worst-case padded len)
     BUF_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
     num_buf,  # buf-zero CTAs occupy pids [1, num_buf]
+    HAS_MASK: tl.constexpr,
     EMIT_MX: tl.constexpr,  # also emit the mxfp8 quant of qx (group_size 32)
     N_COLS: tl.constexpr,
     QCHUNK: tl.constexpr,  # columns per quant iteration (multiple of 32)
@@ -70,6 +91,11 @@ def _moe_sorting_small_kernel(
     # sentinel expert keeps inactive lanes out of every "smaller expert" count
     e = tl.load(topk_ids_ptr + offs_p, mask=mask_p, other=0x7FFFFFFF)
     w = tl.load(topk_weights_ptr + offs_p, mask=mask_p, other=0.0)
+    if HAS_MASK:
+        # from here on mask_p marks the pairs this rank computes
+        e, mask_p = _localize_experts(
+            e, mask_p, expert_mask_ptr, num_experts, E_POW2, 0x7FFFFFFF
+        )
     token = offs_p // TOPK
     slot = offs_p % TOPK
 
@@ -99,6 +125,8 @@ def _moe_sorting_small_kernel(
             offs_g = tl.arange(0, QCHUNK // 32)
             token_p = tl.sum(tl.where(offs_p == p, token, 0), axis=0)
             dest_p = tl.sum(tl.where(offs_p == p, dest, 0), axis=0)
+            # a remote pair has no sorted row; its token's fp8 row is still written
+            local_p = tl.sum(tl.where((offs_p == p) & mask_p, 1, 0), axis=0) > 0
             base_sw = (
                 (dest_p // 32) * (SCALEN_PAD * 32)
                 + (dest_p % 16) * 4
@@ -121,7 +149,7 @@ def _moe_sorting_small_kernel(
                 )
             y = c0 // 32 + offs_g
             sw = base_sw + (y // 8) * 256 + (y % 4) * 64 + ((y % 8) // 4) * 2
-            tl.store(qscale_ptr + sw, exp.to(tl.uint8))
+            tl.store(qscale_ptr + sw, exp.to(tl.uint8), mask=(offs_g >= 0) & local_p)
         return
 
     total_blocks = tl.sum(tl.where(is_leader, blocks_of_e, 0), axis=0)
@@ -294,18 +322,178 @@ def _moe_sorting_small_kernel_distributed(
             tl.store(qscale_ptr + sw, exp.to(tl.uint8))
 
 
+# histogram + bitonic sort keep every pair in registers of one CTA (sglang#41900); with EMIT_MX,
+# one quant CTA per (token, column chunk) writes the fp8 row once and the scale bytes of all its pairs
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["M", "moe_buf_numel", "num_buf"])
+def _moe_sorting_small_kernel_sorted(
+    topk_ids_ptr,  # [M, topk] i32
+    topk_weights_ptr,  # [M, topk] fp32
+    sorted_ids_ptr,  # [max_padded] i32
+    sorted_weights_ptr,  # [max_padded] fp32
+    sorted_expert_ids_ptr,  # [max_blocks] i32
+    num_valid_ids_ptr,  # [2] i32
+    moe_buf_ptr,
+    moe_buf_numel,
+    qx_ptr,  # [M, N_COLS] activations to mx-quantize (EMIT_MX only)
+    qout_ptr,  # [M, N_COLS] fp8 out
+    qscale_ptr,  # swizzled e8m0 bytes, one per (sorted_row, group)
+    expert_mask_ptr,  # [num_experts] i32, 1 = expert on this rank (HAS_MASK only)
+    M,
+    num_experts,
+    TOPK: tl.constexpr,
+    TOPK_POW2: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    P_POW2: tl.constexpr,  # >= M * topk
+    E_POW2: tl.constexpr,  # > num_experts; bin E_POW2 - 1 holds the inactive lanes
+    PAD_POW2: tl.constexpr,  # >= (M * topk) * BLOCK_SIZE (worst-case padded len)
+    BUF_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+    num_buf,  # buf-zero CTAs occupy pids [1, num_buf]
+    HAS_MASK: tl.constexpr,
+    EMIT_MX: tl.constexpr,
+    N_COLS: tl.constexpr,
+    QCHUNK: tl.constexpr,
+    SCALEN_PAD: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    if pid > 0 and pid <= num_buf:
+        offs = (pid - 1) * BUF_BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BUF_BLOCK)
+        tl.store(
+            moe_buf_ptr + offs,
+            tl.zeros((BUF_BLOCK,), moe_buf_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+            mask=offs < moe_buf_numel,
+        )
+        return
+
+    P = M * TOPK
+    offs_p = tl.arange(0, P_POW2)
+    e = tl.load(topk_ids_ptr + offs_p, mask=offs_p < P, other=E_POW2 - 1)
+    if HAS_MASK:
+        # remote pairs join the inactive lanes in bin E_POW2 - 1
+        e, _ = _localize_experts(
+            e, offs_p < P, expert_mask_ptr, num_experts, E_POW2, E_POW2 - 1
+        )
+    offs_e = tl.arange(0, E_POW2)
+    cnt = tl.where(offs_e < E_POW2 - 1, tl.histogram(e, E_POW2), 0)
+    blocks = (cnt + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) // BLOCK_SIZE
+    # first padded row of each expert
+    start = (tl.cumsum(blocks, 0) - blocks) * BLOCK_SIZE
+
+    if EMIT_MX and pid > num_buf:
+        # quant CTA: token t, columns [c0, c0 + QCHUNK); math as fused_dynamic_mxfp8_quant_moe_sort
+        q_id = pid - num_buf - 1
+        CHUNKS: tl.constexpr = N_COLS // QCHUNK
+        t = q_id // CHUNKS
+        c0 = (q_id % CHUNKS) * QCHUNK
+        offs_k = tl.arange(0, TOPK_POW2)
+        mask_k = offs_k < TOPK
+        pk = t * TOPK + offs_k
+        ek = tl.load(topk_ids_ptr + pk, mask=mask_k, other=0)
+        if HAS_MASK:
+            # the fp8 row is written for every token; scale bytes only for local pairs
+            ek, mask_k = _localize_experts(
+                ek, mask_k, expert_mask_ptr, num_experts, E_POW2, 0
+            )
+        # stable rank of each of the token's pairs within its expert
+        same = (e[None, :] == ek[:, None]) & (offs_p[None, :] < pk[:, None])
+        dest = tl.gather(start, ek, 0) + tl.sum(tl.where(same, 1, 0), axis=1)
+
+        offs_q = tl.arange(0, QCHUNK)
+        x = tl.load(qx_ptr + t * N_COLS + c0 + offs_q).to(tl.float32)
+        x2 = tl.reshape(x, (QCHUNK // 32, 32))
+        amax = tl.maximum(tl.max(tl.abs(x2), axis=1), 1e-10)
+        sf = amax * (1.0 / 448.0)
+        bits = sf.to(tl.int32, bitcast=True)
+        exp = (bits >> 23) & 0xFF
+        exp = tl.where((bits & 0x7FFFFF) != 0, exp + 1, exp)
+        scale = (exp << 23).to(tl.float32, bitcast=True)
+        q = tl.clamp(x2 / scale[:, None], -448.0, 448.0)
+        tl.store(
+            qout_ptr + t * N_COLS + c0 + offs_q,
+            tl.reshape(q, (QCHUNK,)).to(qout_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+        )
+        y = c0 // 32 + tl.arange(0, QCHUNK // 32)
+        base_sw = (dest // 32) * (SCALEN_PAD * 32) + (dest % 16) * 4 + (dest % 32) // 16
+        sw = (
+            base_sw[:, None]
+            + ((y // 8) * 256 + (y % 4) * 64 + ((y % 8) // 4) * 2)[None, :]
+        )
+        tl.store(
+            qscale_ptr + sw,
+            (exp[None, :] + tl.zeros((TOPK_POW2, QCHUNK // 32), tl.int32)).to(tl.uint8),
+            mask=mask_k[:, None],
+        )
+        return
+
+    # sorted position of a pair -> padded dest: add the block-tail padding of smaller experts
+    shift = start - (tl.cumsum(cnt, 0) - cnt)
+    num_valid = tl.sum(blocks, 0) * BLOCK_SIZE
+
+    # pad the whole used region first, then scatter the real pairs over it
+    offs_pad = tl.arange(0, PAD_POW2)
+    pad_mask = offs_pad < num_valid
+    tl.store(
+        sorted_ids_ptr + offs_pad,
+        tl.full((PAD_POW2,), (TOPK << 24) | M, tl.int32),
+        mask=pad_mask,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        sorted_weights_ptr + offs_pad, tl.zeros((PAD_POW2,), tl.float32), mask=pad_mask
+    )
+    tl.debug_barrier()
+
+    # stable (expert, pair) order; inactive lanes sort last
+    key = tl.sort(e * P_POW2 + offs_p)
+    es = key // P_POW2
+    ps = key % P_POW2
+    # pairs this rank computes; equals P without an expert mask
+    valid = offs_p < tl.sum(cnt, 0)
+    dest = offs_p + tl.gather(shift, tl.where(valid, es, 0), 0)
+    tl.store(sorted_ids_ptr + dest, ((ps % TOPK) << 24) | (ps // TOPK), mask=valid)
+    tl.store(
+        sorted_weights_ptr + dest,
+        tl.load(topk_weights_ptr + ps, mask=valid, other=0.0),
